author: Xbox
description:
Set years before the events of the main game, Neva: Prologue tells the story of how Alba and Neva first met.

Follow Alba as she chases a trail of white butterflies deep into the corrupted swamps, only to discover a frightened wolf cub, lost and alone. Determined to save her, Alba must earn the young wolf's trust and guide her through the blighted wilderness. Together, they will face new enemies, endure perilous trials, and confront a monstrous force that threatens to tear them apart. The Neva: Prologue DLC is available now!

This time, it’s bigger. More vertical. More dangerous.
And far more rewarding.

Sharpen your blades, embrace the shadows, and get ready to steal what was never meant to be yours.

Styx: Blades of Greed is out now on Xbox Series X|S.
